title: Two-to-four noise estimate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $k$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\{-1,1\}^n$. Write $f_k$ for its degree-$k$ Fourier part and set $\rho=1/\sqrt{3}$. Then the uniform fourth norm of the noise operator applied to $f_k$ equals $\rho^k$ times the uniform fourth norm of $f_k$, and this quantity is at most the uniform second norm of $f_k$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube
